question: The early Turkish rulers ruled between ______ years over Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is **__1206 and 1290__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Delhi Sultanate was an Islamic empire based in Delhi that stretched over 320 years.
 
• The ruling dynasties of Delhi included:
 
 
• Rajput dynasties
 
• Early Turkish rulers also known as Slave dynasty(1206-1290)
 
• Khalji dynasty (1290-1320)
 
• Tughlaq dynasty (1320-1414)
 
• Sayyid dynasty (1414-1451)
 
• Lodi dynasty (1451-1526)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
